<div class="enthusia-wiki">
<p>The Market is Enthusia's protected player-trading area. Players can own stalls, create shops, search for items and bid on stall auctions.</p>
<div class="fact-grid"><div><b>Default owned stalls</b><span>1 per player</span></div><div><b>Daily stall rent</b><span>100</span></div><div><b>Rent grace period</b><span>3 days</span></div><div><b>Shop transaction tax</b><span>2%</span></div><div><b>Default auction length</b><span>24 hours</span></div><div><b>Current auction fee</b><span>0%</span></div></div>
<h2>Stalls</h2><p>A stall is your protected trading/build space inside the Market. Ownership is limited, and a one-owned-stall-per-IP fairness rule also applies.</p>
<p>Guild-aware permissions can allow other players to help with a stall without making them the owner.</p>
<h2>Shops</h2><table class="wikitable enthusia-table"><thead><tr><th>Shop type</th><th>How it works</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><b>SELL</b></td><td>You stock an item; customers pay the listed price to buy it.</td></tr><tr><td><b>BUY</b></td><td>The shop pays players who sell the requested item into it.</td></tr><tr><td><b>TRADE</b></td><td>Trades one configured item for another instead of using a normal currency price.</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p>Use <code>/shop search &lt;item&gt;</code> or <code>/shopsearch</code> to find items being sold in Market shops.</p>
<h2>Rent</h2><p>Rent is currently 100 per day. If it cannot be paid, the stall enters a 3-day grace period and its shops freeze. If the grace period expires, the stall can move into an emergency auction.</p>
<h2>Auctions</h2><p>Stall auctions normally last 24 hours, can range from 15 minutes to 7 days, and have a minimum starting bid of 100. A bid placed in the final 30 seconds extends the auction by 30 seconds so the previous bidder has time to respond.</p>
<details class="enthusia-drop drop"><summary><b>Useful Market commands</b><span>open command list</span></summary><div><table class="wikitable enthusia-table"><tbody><tr><td><code>/em</code></td><td>Open Market commands/menus.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/em auctions</code></td><td>Browse stall auctions.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/em bid &lt;auctionId&gt; &lt;amount&gt;</code></td><td>Bid on a stall auction.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/em stall info &lt;stallId&gt;</code></td><td>Inspect a stall.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/shop search &lt;item&gt;</code></td><td>Search shops for an item. Alias: <code>/shopsearch</code>.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/shopvault</code></td><td>Open your Market/shop vault where applicable.</td></tr></tbody></table></div></details>
</div>
